text.text: You'd be stiff if you'd been sitting on a brick wall all day,

voices.name: Arthur Lane
voices.audio_transcript: Carter Wetherby threw up his snug clarkship, turned the half of his savings over to his wife, and with the remainder bought an outfit.

voices.name: Cathleen McCarron
voices.audio_transcript: Bessy Brunson took a deep breath and prepared to climb a flight of stairs for what seemed like the hundredth time since sunrise. It was not yet noon.
